lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Hello, No. 7.
Is this Ether?

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Wow, how did you know?
You're the only one who refers to me as a number.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Hehe, fair enough.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Did you recently do a favor for Ian Max?

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: I'd like to make a request which pertains to that.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: I've sent you some coordinates, and I'd be quite grateful if you went to check something for me.
Check what, exactly?

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: At those coordinates, there might exist a hole in a wall which seems to be the product of corrosion.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Inside that hole, there might be something of interest.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: An enigmatic slimy substance.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: The color, smell, viscosity...

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: nearly everything about it is a mystery to us.
Sounds suspicious.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Such is the nature of new discoveries, No. 7.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: When you get there, simply confirm if the substance is there.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Don't get too close,

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: or touch it,

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: or smell it.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Simply have one of the Nikkes

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: confirm its existence.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Understand?
Is this related to those corpses we found?

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: The fact they don't exhibit the slightest signs of decomposition

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: after 10 years is most puzzling,

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: along with how they came to swell so large.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: We have encountered similar cases in the past.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: The corpses were found in the same condition,

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: and there was an unidentified slimy substance near them at the time.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: I want to see if we're dealing with the same substance.
I'll check it out.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: Thank you kindly, No. 7.

lines.speaker: mmrguardian
lines.text: I'll leave this in your capable hands.
